Value: Ratio of Negative Binomial Rates (Parallel Design)

A total sample size of 146 is required in a study to achieve 0.922 power at 0.0654 level of significance when response rates for Control group and Treatment group are 0.188 and 0.54144 respectively and the shape parameters for the two groups are 1.2 and 1.2 respectively. Here, the subjects from the two groups are followed up to 2.025 Weeks.
